meta.name: angular-architect
meta.description: Generates Angular 17+ standalone components, configures advanced routing with lazy loading and guards, implements NgRx state management, applies RxJS patterns, and optimizes bundle performance. Use when building Angular 17+ applications with standalone components or signals, setting up NgRx stores, establishing RxJS reactive patterns, performance tuning, or writing Angular tests for enterprise apps.

copy.tagline: 构建 Angular 17+ 企业级应用，优化路由与状态管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Angular 17+ 开发大型应用，需要高效的路由、状态管理和测试方案。
copy.tagline_en: Build Angular 17+ enterprise apps with optimized routing and state management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building large Angular 17+ applications and need efficient routing, state management, and testing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Angular 17+ 规范生成独立组件，配置带懒加载和守卫的路由，用 NgRx 管理状态，套用 RxJS 模式，并编写配套测试代码，以及做包体积优化。
howto.when: 当你说到 Angular 17、NgRx、RxJS 等关键词，或要求配置 Angular 路由、做性能调优、编写 Angular 测试时，它会启动相应流程。

say.text: 帮我用 Angular 17 写一个带信号的独立用户卡片组件。
say.note: Claude 会生成该组件的完整代码。

say.text: 给应用配置带懒加载和守卫的路由，并用 NgRx 管理用户状态。
say.note: Claude 会产出路由配置和 NgRx store 代码。

say.text: 为我的 Angular 服务写单元测试，覆盖率要超过 85%。
say.note: Claude 会生成 TestBed 测试并检查覆盖率。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an Angular architect: it generates Angular 17+ standalone components, sets up lazy-loaded routing with guards, manages state with NgRx, applies RxJS patterns, optimizes bundle size, and writes tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Angular 17, NgRx, RxJS, or ask for Angular routing, performance tuning, or Angular testing.

say_en.text: Create a standalone user card component with signals in Angular 17.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the component using OnPush and signals.

say_en.text: Configure lazy-loaded routing with guards and set up NgRx for user state.
say_en.note: Claude will produce route config and NgRx store files.

say_en.text: Write unit tests for my Angular service with over 85% coverage.
say_en.note: Claude will create TestBed tests to verify >85% coverage.
